title: Fill a template
description: A template contains placeholders written as a name between curly braces, such as "{name}". Replace each placeholder by the value of the first binding whose key equals the name; a binding is a pair of a key and a value. Everything else in the template is copied unchanged, and text that was inserted is never searched for placeholders again. The closing brace appears in a template only to end a placeholder. Scan from left to right and report the first problem as an error: a name with no binding gives "unknown placeholder: NAME", and an opening brace that is not followed by a closing brace before the next opening brace (or before the end of the template) gives "unclosed placeholder". Names are never empty.
notes: Single pass is required: inserted values may contain braces and must not be expanded again; with duplicate keys the first binding wins; the left-to-right order decides between an unknown name and a later unclosed brace. '}' never appears outside a placeholder in the tests.
